items.definition:
a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain worn around the neck
She wore a beautiful silver pendant.

a small bag or sack, typically made of leather or cloth, for carrying small articles
Kangaroos carry their young in a pouch.

a person who publicly demonstrates strong objection to something
The protestors marched peacefully through the streets.

a continuous deep, resonant sound
We heard a distant rumble of thunder.

a public room or building for a specified purpose, especially drinking
The cowboys gathered in the old western saloon.

a roughly built hut or cabin
They lived in a small wooden shack by the river.

a person undergoing training for a particular job or profession
The new trainee is learning quickly.

the act of giving birth
Modern medicine has made childbirth safer for mothers and babies.

an authorized seller of goods, especially cars
We visited the car dealership to look at new models.

a person who eats a particular type or amount of food
He's a picky eater and doesn't like vegetables.

a man from England
He is a proud Englishman, born and raised in London.

substance added to soil to improve plant growth
The farmer spread fertilizer on the fields to help the crops grow.

a small, wingless, jumping insect
My dog had fleas, so we had to give him a special bath.

items of clothing worn on the feet
Please remove your outdoor footwear before entering the house.

a desirable or attractive item
The children were excited to receive goodie bags at the party.

a light, colorless, odorless, inert gaseous element
Balloons filled with helium float in the air.

the state of being annoyed, impatient, or angry; a feeling of soreness or discomfort
The constant noise caused her a great deal of irritation.

a person from Libya
The Libyan delegation arrived for the peace talks.

a strong, synthetic material
These stockings are made of durable nylon.

an attractively arranged bunch of flowers
He gave her a beautiful bouquet of roses.

a building or room used by a club or society
The golf players gathered at the clubhouse after their game.

a cage or pen for poultry
The farmer built a new chicken coop for his hens.

a criminal or a bend/hook
The police caught the crook who stole the car.

an act of asking for information
We received an enquiry about our new product.

a plant that retains its leaves throughout the year
Pine trees are evergreens, keeping their needles all winter.

a spirit of Arabian folklore, typically trapped in a lamp or bottle
Aladdin rubbed the lamp and a genie appeared.

a sticky, viscous, or messy substance
The spilled syrup turned into a sticky goo on the counter.

informal term for husband
My hubby and I are going out for dinner tonight.

a narrow flat projection from a wall or cliff
The bird built its nest on a narrow ledge.

mother (informal)
My momma always told me to be kind.

a long bench with a back, used for seating in a church
We sat in the front pew during the wedding ceremony.

a type of handgun
The police officer drew his revolver from its holster.

a small wave or series of waves on the surface of water
A stone thrown into the pond created ripples.

the branch of mathematics dealing with the properties and manipulation of numbers
Basic arithmetic skills are essential for everyday life.

a scientist who studies astronomy
The astronomer discovered a new galaxy.

a woman or girl with dark brown hair
The actress is a natural brunette.

a compact case containing a length of magnetic tape, used for recording and playing back sound or video
He found an old music cassette in the attic.

the care of children, especially while parents are working
Finding affordable childcare is a challenge for many families.

close acquaintance with or knowledge of something
His familiarity with the local customs helped him adapt quickly.

a musical instrument
She learned to play the harp when she was young.

a woman whose main occupation is managing a household
My grandmother was a housewife for most of her life.

a team sport
Lacrosse is a fast-paced sport played with a stick and a ball.

food remaining after a meal
We had chicken and rice for dinner, and there were plenty of leftovers.

a large, extinct elephant-like animal
Woolly mammoths roamed the Earth during the Ice Age.

a device that modulates and demodulates signals for data transmission
You need a modem to connect to the internet.

a minute opening in a surface, especially the skin
Sweat is released through the pores of the skin.

a symbol representing a smiling face, often used in digital communication
She ended her text message with a smiley face.

a person who designs or advises on styles, especially in fashion or hair
She hired a personal stylist for the awards ceremony.

a short form of 'video'
Did you see that funny vid online?

a singer, especially in a band or group
The band's new vocalist has an amazing voice.

Anno Domini (in the year of the Lord), used to indicate years since the birth of Jesus Christ
The Roman Empire fell in 476 A.D.

a robber or outlaw
The bandits ambushed the stagecoach on the mountain road.

soup consisting of meat or vegetable stock
She made a warm chicken broth to help with his cold.

A type of strong black coffee.
I'll have a double espresso, please.

A microorganism, especially one that causes disease.
Wash your hands to get rid of germs.

The back of a horse.
They explored the trails on horseback.

A direct telephone line for urgent calls.
You can call the customer service hotline for assistance.

a thing used to make something look more attractive
She placed a small ceramic ornament on the shelf.

the smallest finger on the hand
He held up his pinky finger.

a dense forest in tropical areas with heavy rainfall
The Amazon is the world's largest rainforest.

a gambling game in which a ball is dropped onto a revolving wheel with numbered compartments
He lost all his money playing roulette.

the basic monetary unit of India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Mauritius, and Seychelles
The exchange rate for the Indian rupee has changed.

a smooth, glossy fabric, typically of silk or rayon, woven with a satin weave
The dress was made of soft satin.

the time at which a show or performance is scheduled to begin
It's almost showtime, so we should find our seats.
